command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$projects=@('CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04'); `$nodes=@('PE1','PE2','PE3'); foreach(`$p in `$projects){foreach(`$n in `$nodes){`$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ('http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd=display%20current-configuration') -Method Get).output; `$m=(`$o -split '`r?`n' | Where-Object {`$_ -match 'static-lsp|route-static 150|route-static 160'}); Write-Output ('['+`$p+' '+`$n+']'); `$m}}"
